text:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock the release-track for next Tue. Who is claiming the 09:00 UTC deploy slot for the model-serving change?

alex: I can take 09:00 if no objections. planning to run the smoke checklist in PR #423.

sam: I'm on-call at 09 but can hand off monitoring to alex at 08:50. @alex please confirm rollback window and who triggers it.

alex: Confirmed. rollback window 09:10-09:25. If we hit the error threshold we stop and revert. smoke steps I'll run: small canary, latency check, and end-to-end prompt sample.

devon: FYI infra will warm up reserved capacity 08:30-08:50 in the region. please don't attempt the deploy earlier — it can cause cold-start noise.

natalie: QA will start canary traffic at 09:05 for ~10m. Abort if errors >0.5% or regression on top-3 prompts. We'll post results in this thread.

alex: Smoke commands I'm using:
```bash
# small canary
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/serve -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq .status
# latency probe
for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -w '\\n%{time_total}' -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.dev/v1/serve; done
```

deploy-bot: :gear: deploy queued by alex for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z. id=deploy-2026-03-25-09. Prechecks: capacity-warmup OK, infra-health OK.

maria: Thanks. @alex when smoke passes, drop a one-line summary + token costs and 95p latency in here. if anything nontrivial needs a rollback, ping @sam and tag the deploy id. :thumbsup:

alex: Will report back with: smoke=pass, 95p=120ms, tokens=~2.4k for the sample set. Posting after verification.

sam: I'll be watching logs and have rollback plan ready (manual revert + trigger canary to previous model).

maria: Great — locking the slot to alex. If any timing slips please update this thread immediately so infra can adjust warmups.

alex: Noted. thanks everyone.

natalie: QA will post canary metrics ~09:15.

devon: I'll keep infra on standby until 09:30.

maria: Closing loop — slot claimed and checklist assigned. If anything changes ping here.
